Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Shedd
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/18/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 61 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Physical Therapy until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Shedd
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 61 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the Board of Physical Therapy until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
